title: NAPCC National Mission For A Green India
definition: One of the eight missions under the National Action Plan on Climate Change (NAPCC), GIM aims to protect, restore, and enhance India's forest cover and respond to climate change through a combination of adaptation and mitigation measures.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in the context of India's Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) under the Paris Agreement, carbon sequestration targets, and sustainable development goals (SDG 13 and 15).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of NAPCC National Mission For A Green India.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
